dataset_role: prospectively reserved one-shot dataset-specific external confirmation of frozen DCS-OPCT v11 on an openly accessible sparse wearable-EEG cohort
scientific_scope: cross-dataset and cross-device transfer to independently collected four-channel Muse S EEG during four shared affective film clips

source.expected_public_scale: 47 participants, four affective film trials plus baseline, Muse S EEG, and SAM responses

relationship_to_existing_reservations.reporting_rule: EKM-ED is added because its official archive is openly accessible, not because an outcome was observed. Every attempted EKM-ED one-shot outcome is retained, including ineligibility, abstention, null, or harmful results.
relationship_to_existing_reservations.dataset_specific_claim: A passing EKM-ED result may support prospective dataset-specific external effectiveness with bounded released-action non-harm.
relationship_to_existing_reservations.replication_claim: EKM-ED alone cannot support replicated external effectiveness and does not alter the previously frozen AMIGOS-plus-Emognition replication rule.
relationship_to_existing_reservations.unavailable_dataset_rule: AMIGOS and Emognition access failures remain reported as access failures and supply no effectiveness or safety evidence.

cohort_contract.participants: all 47 publicly described participants are attempted
cohort_contract.stimulus_trials: anger, sadness, happiness, and fear film clips; the baseline film is excluded from the primary endpoint
cohort_contract.participant_task_requirements: at least one high and one low label, all four registered EEG channels, and at least three valid four-second key-moment windows in every retained trial
cohort_contract.exclusions: only absent or unreadable registered files, absent registered channels, nonfinite signal, irreconcilable timestamp alignment, SAM values outside the locked one-to-nine scale, midpoint questionnaire label, or fewer than three valid key-moment windows; no exclusion based on identity encoding, classifier accuracy, material events, risk score, calibration action, or certificate
cohort_contract.hard_failure: stop before model fitting for a task if fewer than 30 participants meet its locked requirements

task_contract.label_source: participant SAM response for each of the four affective film clips
task_contract.label_rule: high if integer rating >= 6, low if integer rating <= 4, and rating 5 excluded as the nine-point scale midpoint
task_contract.schema_failure_rule: if the official questionnaire does not provide unambiguous one-to-nine participant-level valence and arousal ratings for the four film clips, the corresponding task fails structurally without substitute labeling
task_contract.forbidden_relabeling: no sample median, prevalence target, intended film category, model output, performance, or calibration-dependent thresholding
task_contract.claim_boundary: The tasks concern participant-reported experienced affect and are not interchangeable with intended film categories.

trial_contract.stimulus_identity: the four affective film clips shared across participants
trial_contract.pseudoreplication_rule: one aggregate feature vector per participant-film pair; key moments, windows, samples, and device packets are not independent trials

feature_contract.source_branch: official preprocessed clean-signals Muse branch at sampling interval 0.0078125 seconds
feature_contract.key_moment_policy: use only the publicly declared clip-specific key-moment timestamps; extract complete four-second windows centered on each timestamp and aggregate all valid key-moment windows to one participant-film vector
feature_contract.construction: official clean 128-Hz four-channel signals, common-average reference, linear detrending, Welch PSD, fixed band integration, and mean/population-SD/least-squares-slope summaries identical to the frozen wearable feature core
feature_contract.baseline_policy: the baseline film is not used in the primary one-shot representation; any baseline-referenced analysis is post-primary exploratory and cannot change the registered action or claim
feature_contract.unavailable_representation_policy: hard failure rather than channel substitution, full-clip replacement, intended-category relabeling, or feature replacement

dcs_opct_v11_contract.one_shot_rule: the first locked complete execution is the only confirmatory EKM-ED analysis; later cohort, label, preprocessing, key-moment, channel, seed, fold, feature, or baseline variants are exploratory

acceptance_gate.endpoint_eligibility: both audit and held-out partitions contain at least one material event and one non-event; otherwise discrimination and calibration effectiveness are non-estimable
acceptance_gate.effectiveness: a non-identity action is applicable, independently certified, and has held-out Brier gain greater than 0.001
acceptance_gate.released_action_nonharm: held-out Brier gain is nonnegative, held-out AUROC delta is at least -0.02, rank is at least 0.999999, and order inversions equal zero
acceptance_gate.identity_fallback: identity is non-intervention and is not evidence of effectiveness or safety success
acceptance_gate.failure_policy: all acquisition, archive-integrity, structural, construction, endpoint-eligibility, applicability, certification, effectiveness, and non-harm failures remain reportable and immutable

execution_order: validate this reservation and the unchanged v11 freeze
download the official Zenodo archive without opening participant members
verify exact byte size and MD5 checksum
write and hash a central-directory schema manifest before parsing participant values
implement and test the schema-specific adapter on synthetic fixtures
parse participant, trial, questionnaire, and EEG values once
run the registered feature construction and counterfactual experiment once
write and hash the unlabeled action and audit assignment before attaching material-event outcomes
apply frozen DCS-OPCT v11 once and preserve every outcome
claim_boundary: This reservation authorizes a future one-shot EKM-ED evaluation. It does not assert archive integrity, structural eligibility, endpoint variation, applicability, effectiveness, non-harm, safety, or replicated confirmation.
